title: Splunk Protocol Impersonation Weak Encryption Configuration
author: Lou Stella, Splunk
description: The following analytic identifies weak encryption configurations in Splunk related to TLS validation within the httplib and urllib Python libraries. It uses REST API calls to check specific configuration settings on the search head and its peers, ensuring compliance with security advisories. This activity is significant for a SOC as weak encryption can be exploited for protocol impersonation attacks, leading to unauthorized access. If confirmed malicious, attackers could intercept and manipulate data, compromising the integrity and confidentiality of the Splunk environment.
